about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to be a cat?

To eat, sleep and play without a care in the world? Well, wish granted in NEKO NEKO LOVE, a cozy fantasy visual novel.

You play as the cat, an immortal creature inspired by Japanese folklore, who once swore never to bond with a new master after losing the last one. The past leaves its marks…

Years later, here you are—lost on a new continent, you’ll need to find shelter with a human before the terrifying Magic Storm descends upon the city.
Obviously, it couldn’t be easy.

Forced by fate, your cat must grow closer (your choice!) to a perpetually broke student mage, a naïve young witch, or a former mercenary turned gardener. A dream cast, right?

Following the tradition of romance games, you’ll have to find your place in their daily lives before it’s too late. Feeling like Tom Cruise yet?

A gameplay based on choices and consequences

Through both small and major decisions, you’ll shape your feline’s personality as the story unfolds—
Will your cat be wild or cuddly? Mischievous or serious?

Colorful, relatable characters

In a world where magic meets modern life, you’ll discover a cast of realistic and endearing characters.
Struggles with anxiety, the search for independence, financial trouble… sound familiar?
Not for the cat! he need to learn some empathy to win over their Meow Interests.

A visual style blending Europe and Japan

Love games with soul? So do we.

Neko Neko Love features a unique art style inspired by paper theater and kamishibai, offering a look that’s both delicate and immersive.
You’ll find a magical world where Japanese and European influences come together beautifully.
Every background and character is lovingly hand-drawn—no AI involved—to preserve the warmth and authenticity of art.

A unique soundtrack

Close your eyes and let yourself drift with dreamy lofi, mysterious jazz, or heartfelt fantasy melodies.
Okay, open them back up—you’ve got some reading to do.
The soundtrack is designed to immerse you without pulling your focus. Amazing, right?

Support an indie studio!

We’re a small team on a mission to bring beauty, emotion, and originality back to visual novels.

With Neko Neko Love, you’re adding a little magic to your everyday life… and to ours.
